snippet.title: Pit-Fighter (Genesis) Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A playthrough of Tengen's 1991 Sega Genesis fighting game, Pit-Fighter. 

Played through as Buzz on the default difficulty setting. 

It's rough on the eyes, but among the 8 and 16-bit home ports, it's easily the closest to the arcade version. Well, maybe except for the Lynx version. It made its own compromises, but was actually a bit closer. Still, the Genesis version is great. 
_________
No cheats were used during the recording of this video.
